name: ADO SQL v2
description: Monitors any data source that is available via OLE DB or ODBC
help: Requires .NET 4.7.2 on the probe system.

name: AWS Alarm v2
description: Monitors the status of an AWS alarm by reading its data from Amazon CloudWatch
help: Requires credentials for AWS. Shows the status and other metrics of an AWS alarm. Every sensor scan can generate costs in your AWS account based on the number of API calls.

name: AWS Cost
description: Monitors the costs of an Amazon Web Services account by reading its data from AWS Cost Explorer
help: Requires credentials for AWS. Shows various monthly and yearly costs and forecasts. Every sensor scan can generate costs in your AWS account based on the number of API calls.

name: AWS EBS v2
description: Monitors the status of an AWS EBS volume by reading its data from Amazon CloudWatch
help: Requires credentials for AWS. Shows the status and various read and write statistics of an AWS EBS volume. Every sensor scan can generate costs in your AWS account based on the number of API calls.

name: AWS EC2 v2
description: Monitors the performance of an AWS EC2 instance by reading its data from Amazon CloudWatch
help: Requires credentials for AWS. Shows the status of the instance and the system, and metrics regarding CPU utilization and network traffic. Every sensor scan can generate costs in your AWS account based on the number of API calls.

name: AWS ELB v2
description: Monitors the performance of an AWS ELB load balancer by reading its data from Amazon CloudWatch
help: Requires credentials for AWS. Shows the hosts' health and the number of HTTP error and response codes. Every sensor scan can generate costs in your AWS account based on the number of API calls.

name: AWS RDS v2
description: Monitors the performance of an AWS RDS database by reading its data from Amazon CloudWatch
help: Requires credentials for AWS. Shows the CPU utilization, network traffic, and I/O operations. Every sensor scan can generate costs in your AWS account based on the number of API calls.

name: Active Directory Replication Errors
description: Checks Windows domain controllers for replication errors
help: Requires .NET 4.7.2 on the probe system. Requires credentials for Windows systems.

name: Beckhoff IPC System Health
description: Monitors the system health of a Beckhoff IPC via OPC UA
help: Requires credentials for OPC UA. Shows the CPU load, temperature, and available memory.

name: Business Process
description: Monitors several business process components
help: Shows the summarized state of the business process. To perform calculations with values from other sensors, use the Sensor Factory sensor instead.

name: Cisco IP SLA
description: Monitors VoIP network parameters using IP SLA from Cisco
help: Requires IP SLA on the target device. Uses SNMP.

name: Cisco Meraki License
description: Monitors the Meraki licenses of an organization via the Cisco Meraki Dashboard API
help: Requires credentials for Cisco Meraki. Shows the total number of licenses, the license model, and when the next license expires.

name: Cisco Meraki Network Health
description: Monitors the health of Cisco Meraki network devices via the Cisco Meraki Dashboard API
help: Requires credentials for Cisco Meraki. Shows the status of the uplinks and the status of MX, MS, MR, MV, and IOT devices in the monitored network.

name: Cisco WLC Access Point Overview
description: Monitors the status of a Cisco WLC access point
help: Requires SNMP credentials. Shows the operational status and network utilization of an access point. Network utilization metrics are a combination of slot values.

name: Citrix XenServer Host
description: Monitors a Citrix XenServer host as of version 5.0
help: Requires .NET 4.7.2 on the probe system. Requires credentials for VMware/XenServer. Uses the Xen SDK dll and HTTP. The parent device must be a XenServer as of version 5.0.

name: Citrix XenServer Virtual Machine
description: Monitors a virtual machine on a Citrix XenServer as of version 5.0
help: Requires .NET 4.7.2 on the probe system. Requires credentials for VMware/XenServer. Uses the Xen SDK dll and HTTP. The parent device must be a XenServer as of version 5.0.

name: Cloud HTTP v2
description: Monitors a web server and shows the loading time from different locations on a number of continents
help: Requires access to the internet. The probe system must be able to communicate with PRTG Cloud. The address in the parent device settings must be reachable over the internet. You cannot monitor localhost or target devices that are only reachable within your private network.

name: Cloud Ping v2
description: Monitors the ping time to the target device from different locations on a number of continents
help: Requires access to the internet. The probe system must be able to communicate with PRTG Cloud. The address in the parent device settings must be reachable over the internet. You cannot monitor localhost or target devices that are only reachable within your private network.

name: Core Health
description: Monitors the health of the PRTG core server
help: You can find more information related to the PRTG core server system under Setup | PRTG Status.

name: DHCP
description: Monitors if a probe device can request an IP address via DHCP
help: The probe device requires a static IP address. Do not create more than 2 DHCP sensors per device.

name: DICOM Bandwidth
description: Monitors the bandwidth usage of a C-STORE request to a DICOM-capable device
help: Requires .NET 4.7.2 on the probe system. Sends DICOM files to the target device and shows the bandwidth usage.

name: DICOM C-ECHO
description: Monitors the availability of DICOM-capable systems and devices
help: Requires .NET 4.7.2 on the probe system. Shows the response time of a DICOM device using C-ECHO.

name: DICOM Query/Retrieve
description: Monitors the C-FIND capability of DICOM-capable systems and devices
help: Requires .NET 4.7.2 on the probe system. Shows the item count and response time for a C-FIND search level. You can also use MWL queries.

name: DNS v2
description: Monitors a DNS server
help: Shows the response time of a DNS server and if records were resolved. Add this sensor to the device on which the DNS service runs.

name: Dell EMC Unity Enclosure Health v2
description: Monitors a DAE or a physical or virtual DPE on a Dell EMC storage system via the REST API
help: Shows the health status of a Dell EMC DAE or DPE. Supports systems from the Dell EMC Unity family with Unity OE 5.x.

name: Dell EMC Unity File System v2
description: Monitors a file system on a Dell EMC storage system via the REST API
help: Shows the size of a file system. Supports systems from the Dell EMC Unity family with Unity OE 5.x.

name: Dell EMC Unity Storage Capacity v2
description: Monitors the storage capacity of a Dell EMC storage system via the REST API
help: Shows the free, total, and used size. Supports systems from the Dell EMC Unity family with Unity OE 5.x.

name: Dell EMC Unity Storage LUN v2
description: Monitors a LUN on a Dell EMC storage system via the REST API
help: Shows the health status and size of a Dell EMC LUN. Supports systems from the Dell EMC Unity family with Unity OE 5.x.

name: Dell EMC Unity Storage Pool v2
description: Monitors a storage pool on a Dell EMC storage system via the REST API
help: Shows the health status and size of a storage pool. Supports systems from the Dell EMC Unity family with Unity OE 5.x.

name: Dell EMC Unity VMware Datastore v2
description: Monitors a VMware datastore on a Dell EMC storage system via the REST API
help: Shows the number of virtual machines and virtual drives. Supports systems from the Dell EMC Unity family with Unity OE 5.x.

name: Dell PowerVault MDi Logical Disk
description: Monitors the status of a logical drive on a Dell PowerVault MD3000
help: Requires Dell Modular Disk Storage Manager on the probe system.

name: Dell PowerVault MDi Physical Disk
description: Monitors the status of a physical drive on a Dell PowerVault MD3000
help: Requires Dell Modular Disk Storage Manager on the probe system.

name: Docker Container Status
description: Monitors the status, uptime, CPU, memory, and network usage of a Docker container
help: This sensor will be discontinued and replaced in the future. For more information about this development, see the PRTG roadmap. The parent device must be a Docker machine instance.

name: EXE/Script
description: Runs an executable file, dynamic-link library file, or a script (batch file, VBScript, PowerShell) that returns a numeric value
help: Requires .NET 4.7.2 on the probe system. The executable file or script file must be stored on the probe system.

name: EXE/Script Advanced
description: Runs an executable file, dynamic-link library file, or a script (batch file, VBScript, PowerShell) that returns XML or JSON
help: Requires .NET 4.7.2 on the probe system. The executable file or script file must be stored on the probe system.

name: Event Log (Windows API)
description: Monitors Event Log entries using the Windows API
help: Requires credentials for Windows systems.

name: Exchange Backup (PowerShell)
description: Monitors backups of an Exchange server using Remote PowerShell
help: Requires .NET 4.7.2 on the probe system. Requires credentials for Windows systems. The parent device must be a supported Exchange server that hosts the database you want to monitor.

name: Exchange Database (PowerShell)
description: Monitors database information of an Exchange server using Remote PowerShell
help: Requires .NET 4.7.2 on the probe system. Requires credentials for Windows systems. The parent device must be a supported Exchange server that hosts the database you want to monitor.

name: Exchange Database DAG (PowerShell)
description: Monitors the DAG status of a database on an Exchange server using Remote PowerShell
help: Requires .NET 4.7.2 on the probe system. Requires credentials for Windows systems. The parent device must be a supported Exchange server in a valid DAG and must host the database you want to monitor.

name: Exchange Mail Queue (PowerShell)
description: Monitors the number of items in the outgoing mail queue of an Exchange server using Remote PowerShell
help: Requires .NET 4.7.2 on the probe system. Requires credentials for Windows systems. The parent device must be a supported Exchange server.

name: Exchange Mailbox (PowerShell)
description: Monitors the mailbox information of an Exchange server using Remote PowerShell
help: Needs .NET 4.7.2 on the probe system. Needs valid credentials for Windows systems in the settings of the parent device or group. The parent device must be a supported Exchange server.

name: Exchange Public Folder (PowerShell)
description: Monitors the public folder information of an Exchange server using Remote PowerShell
help: Requires .NET 4.7.2 on the probe system. Requires credentials for Windows systems. The parent device must be a supported Exchange server.

name: FTP
description: Monitors FTP servers and FTPS servers
help: Shows the response time and response message of the server.

name: FTP Server File Count
description: Monitors the number of files on an FTP server
help: Requires .NET 4.7.2 on the probe system.

name: FTP Server File Count v2
description: Monitors the number of files on an FTP server
help: Requires credentials for FTP.

name: File
description: Monitors a file using SMB
help: Requires credentials for Windows systems. Shows the file size and when the file was last modified.

name: File Content
description: Monitors the last occurrence of a specified string in a file, for example, a log file
help: Requires credentials for Windows systems.

name: Folder
description: Monitors a folder using SMB
help: Requires credentials for Windows systems. Shows the file age, file size, file count, and changes.

name: FortiGate System Statistics
description: Monitors the system health of a Fortinet FortiGate firewall via the REST API
help: Requires credentials for FortiGate. Shows the CPU usage, memory usage, and sessions.

name: FortiGate VPN Overview
description: Monitors the VPN connections of a Fortinet FortiGate system via the REST API
help: Requires credentials for FortiGate. Shows the number of connected SSL clients and the number of up and down IPsec tunnels.

name: Green IT
description: We all want green IT
help: Good news for the system administrator. This sensor always shows the Up status.

name: HL7
description: Monitors the availability of HL7-capable systems and devices
help: Requires .NET 4.7.2 on the probe system. Sends an HL7 message to the target device, checks for a valid response, and shows the response time.

name: HPE 3PAR Common Provisioning Group
description: Monitors a Common Provisioning Group of an HPE 3PAR storage system
help: Requires credentials for HPE 3PAR. Shows the status and various capacity metrics.

name: HPE 3PAR Drive Enclosure
description: Monitors a drive enclosure of an HPE 3PAR storage system
help: Requires credentials for HPE 3PAR. Shows the status of the drive enclosure, power supplies, and drives.

name: HPE 3PAR Virtual Volume
description: Monitors a virtual volume of an HPE 3PAR storage system
help: Requires credentials for HPE 3PAR. Shows the status and various capacity metrics.

name: HTTP
description: Monitors a web server using HTTP
help: Shows if a website or a specific website element is reachable.

name: HTTP Advanced
description: Monitors a web server using HTTP
help: Provides advanced options and supports more parameters than the HTTP sensor. Supports authentication, content checks, and other parameters.

name: HTTP Apache ModStatus PerfStats
description: Monitors performance statistics of an Apache web server using mod_status over HTTP
help: Shows the CPU load, server uptime, requests per second, bytes per request, and number of busy and idle worker threads.

name: HTTP Apache ModStatus Totals
description: Monitors an Apache web server using mod_status over HTTP
help: Shows the number of accesses and kilobytes of data transferred per second.

name: HTTP Content
description: Monitors a numeric value returned by an HTTP request
help: The return value must be placed between [ ] brackets in the returned HTML page.

name: HTTP Data Advanced
description: Accesses a web server and retrieves data in XML-encoded or JSON-encoded format
help: The data returned by the HTTP server must be in a format as defined in the [a href='/help/custom_sensors.htm#advanced_sensors' target='_blank' rel='noopener noreferrer']]PRTG API[/a] (XML or JSON).

name: HTTP IoT Push Data Advanced
description: Displays data from XML-encoded messages that are pushed to PRTG via an HTTPS request
help: Provides a URL that you can use to push messages to the probe system via HTTPS.

name: HTTP Push Count
description: Counts received messages that are pushed to PRTG via an HTTP request
help: Provides a URL that you can use to push messages to the probe system via HTTP (secured with TLS 1.2 or not secure).

name: HTTP Push Data
description: Displays numeric values from messages that are pushed to PRTG via an HTTP request
help: Provides a URL that you can use to push messages to the probe system via HTTP or HTTPS.

name: HTTP Push Data Advanced
description: Displays data from XML-encoded messages that are pushed to PRTG via an HTTP request
help: Provides a URL that you can use to push messages to the probe system via HTTP or HTTPS.

name: HTTP Transaction
description: Monitors a web server by performing a transaction using a set of URLs
help: Monitors whether logins or shopping carts work properly.

name: HTTP Webpage
description: Monitors the full page load time of a Google Chrome webpage
help: Shows the total loading time of a webpage and all its resources, such as JavaScript, CSS, images, and fonts. The sensor loads the page in Google Chrome running in headless mode.

name: HTTP XML/REST Value
description: Retrieves an .xml file via HTTP and returns the value of an XML node (JSON allowed)
help: Requires .NET 4.7.2 on the probe system.

name: HTTP v2
description: Monitors a server using HTTP
help: Shows the response time and the HTTP response code of an HTTP request, and the received bytes.

name: Hyper-V Cluster Shared Volume Disk Free
description: Monitors the usage of a Microsoft Hyper-V cluster shared volume
help: Requires .NET 4.7.2 on the probe system. Requires credentials for Windows systems. Requires Remote PowerShell and WSFC PowerShell Interface on the target system.

name: Hyper-V Host Server
description: Monitors a Hyper-V host server
help: Requires credentials for Windows systems. The parent device must be a Windows server running Hyper-V.

name: Hyper-V Virtual Machine
description: Monitors a virtual machine on a Hyper-V server
help: Requires credentials for Windows systems. The parent device must be a Windows server running Hyper-V.

name: Hyper-V Virtual Network Adapter
description: Monitors a Hyper-V virtual network adapter
help: Requires credentials for Windows systems. The parent device must be a Windows server running Hyper-V.

name: Hyper-V Virtual Storage Device
description: Monitors a Hyper-V virtual storage device
help: Requires credentials for Windows systems. The parent device must be a Windows server running Hyper-V.

name: IMAP
description: Monitors an email server using IMAP
help: Also monitors backup solutions that send emails (content check included).

name: IP Reputation Score
description: Checks the IP address of the parent device against DNS blacklist servers
help: Checks the IP address of the parent device against a configurable list of DNS blacklist (DNSBL) servers.

name: IP on DNS Blacklist
description: Checks the IP address of the parent device against a number of blacklist servers
help: Requires .NET 4.7.2 on the probe system.

name: IPFIX
description: Monitors a device using IPFIX
help: Requires IPFIX export on the device.

name: IPFIX (Custom)
description: Monitors a device using IPFIX (customizable)
help: Requires IPFIX export on the device.

name: IPMI System Health
description: Monitors the state of a system via IPMI
help: Requires .NET 4.7.2 on the probe system. Shows values such as temperature, fan, voltage, and power supply.

name: LDAP
description: Monitors LDAP directory services
help: Shows the response time of the directory service. Supports Active Directory, OpenLDAP, etc.

name: Local Folder
description: Monitors a local folder on a probe system
help: Shows the number of files, the folder size, and the age of the newest and oldest file.

name: MQTT Round Trip
description: Monitors the availability of an MQTT broker (server)
help: Requires credentials for MQTT. Shows the status of the round trip, the publisher and subscriber connection time, and the round-trip time.

name: MQTT Statistics
description: Monitors collected statistics about incoming messages on a topic
help: Requires credentials for MQTT. Shows the number of active topics, messages received, and payload bytes received.

name: MQTT Subscribe Custom
description: Monitors values queried from the received JSON data of a subscribed MQTT topic
help: Requires credentials for MQTT. Shows up to 10 numeric values.

name: Microsoft 365 Mailbox
description: Monitors a Microsoft 365 mailbox folder
help: Requires credentials for Microsoft 365. Shows the number of mails and the age of the oldest and newest mail.

name: Microsoft 365 Service Status
description: Monitors the overall status of all services of a Microsoft 365 subscription
help: Requires credentials for Microsoft 365 for authenticating with Microsoft Entra ID and an active Microsoft 365 subscription. Shows the number of operational, degraded, and interrupted services.

name: Microsoft 365 Service Status Advanced
description: Monitors the detailed status of a service of a Microsoft 365 subscription
help: Requires credentials for Microsoft 365 for authenticating with Microsoft Entra ID and an active Microsoft 365 subscription. Shows the status of the monitored service.

name: Microsoft Azure SQL Database
description: Monitors the metrics of an Azure SQL Database in a Microsoft Azure subscription
help: Requires credentials for Microsoft Entra ID. Shows the CPU usage, and various data and DTU metrics. Make sure that you assigned the correct permissions and roles in your Microsoft Azure subscription.

name: Microsoft Azure Storage Account
description: Monitors the storage account in a Microsoft Azure subscription
help: Requires credentials for Microsoft Entra ID. Shows the average E2E latency, storage latency, and the total egress and ingress. Make sure that you assigned the correct permissions and roles in your Microsoft Azure subscription.

name: Microsoft Azure Subscription Cost
description: Monitors the cost in a Microsoft Azure subscription
help: Requires credentials for Microsoft Entra ID. Shows the current period cost, the amount of budget used, and the cost forecast. Make sure that you assigned the correct permissions and roles in your Microsoft Azure subscription.

name: Microsoft Azure Virtual Machine
description: Monitors the status of a virtual machine in a Microsoft Azure subscription
help: Requires credentials for Microsoft Entra ID. Shows the average CPU usage, the number of consumed and remaining CPU credits, and the status of the virtual machine. Make sure that you assigned the correct permissions and roles in your Microsoft Azure subscription.

name: Microsoft SQL v2
description: Monitors a database on a Microsoft SQL server
help: Requires .NET 4.7.2 on the probe system.

name: Modbus RTU Custom
description: Monitors values returned by a Modbus RTU device
help: Shows up to ten Modbus values.

name: Modbus TCP Custom
description: Monitors values returned by a Modbus TCP server
help: Shows up to ten Modbus values.

name: MySQL v2
description: Monitors a database on a MySQL server
help: Requires .NET 4.7.2 on the probe system.

name: NATS Server Overview
description: Monitors the status of a NATS server
help: Requires credentials for NATS. Shows the CPU usage and various statistics of a NATS server.

name: NetApp Aggregate
description: Monitors size and files of a NetApp cDOT or ONTAP storage aggregate using SOAP
help: Requires .NET 4.7.2 on the probe system. Supports NetApp cDOT as of version 8.3 and NetApp ONTAP as of version 9.0 up to version 9.12.

name: NetApp Aggregate v2
description: Monitors an aggregate of a NetApp storage system via the REST API
help: Requires as of ONTAP 9.6. Requires credentials for NetApp. Shows the status, the free size, and the number of disks of an aggregate.

name: NetApp I/O
description: Monitors traffic and disk throughput (IOPS) of a NetApp cDOT or ONTAP storage system using SOAP
help: Requires .NET 4.7.2 on the probe system. Supports NetApp cDOT as of version 8.3 and NetApp ONTAP as of version 9.0 up to version 9.12.

name: NetApp I/O v2
description: Monitors the input and output operations of a NetApp storage system via the REST API
help: Requires as of ONTAP 9.11. Requires credentials for NetApp. Shows the operations per second and the data read and write counters of a node.

name: NetApp LIF
description: Monitors logical interfaces of a NetApp cluster using SOAP
help: Requires .NET 4.7.2 on the probe system. Supports NetApp cDOT as of version 8.3 and NetApp ONTAP as of version 9.0 up to version 9.12.

name: NetApp LIF v2
description: Monitors a logical interface of a NetApp storage system via the REST API
help: Requires as of ONTAP 9.10. Requires credentials for NetApp. Shows the status of the LIF, the throughput, and the 'is home' status.

name: NetApp LUN
description: Monitors the LUN of a NetApp cDOT or ONTAP storage system using SOAP
help: Requires .NET 4.7.2 on the probe system. Supports NetApp cDOT as of version 8.3 and NetApp ONTAP as of version 9.0 up to version 9.12.

name: NetApp LUN v2
description: Monitors the LUN of a NetApp storage system via the REST API
help: Requires as of ONTAP 9.6. Requires credentials for NetApp. Shows the status and statistical data.

name: NetApp NIC
description: Monitors the NIC of a NetApp cDOT or ONTAP cluster using SOAP
help: Requires .NET 4.7.2 on the probe system. Supports NetApp cDOT as of version 8.3 and NetApp ONTAP as of version 9.0 up to version 9.12.

name: NetApp NIC v2
description: Monitors an ethernet card of a NetApp storage system via the REST API
help: Requires as of ONTAP 9.10. Requires credentials for NetApp. Shows the status, throughput, error and link-down counts.

name: NetApp Physical Disk
description: Monitors disks of a NetApp cDOT or ONTAP storage system using SOAP
help: Requires .NET 4.7.2 on the probe system. Supports NetApp cDOT as of version 8.3 and NetApp ONTAP as of version 9.0 up to version 9.12.

name: NetApp Physical Disk v2
description: Monitors disks of a NetApp storage cluster via the REST API
help: Requires as of ONTAP 9.9. Requires credentials for NetApp. Shows the throughput, operations, latency, path error count, and power on hours of a disk.

name: NetApp SnapMirror
description: Monitors SnapMirror relationships of a NetApp cDOT or ONTAP storage system using SOAP
help: Requires .NET 4.7.2 on the probe system. Supports NetApp cDOT as of version 8.3 and NetApp ONTAP as of version 9.0 up to version 9.12.

name: NetApp SnapMirror v2
description: Monitors a SnapMirror relationship of a NetApp storage system via the REST API
help: Requires as of ONTAP 9.6. Requires credentials for NetApp. Shows the health of the SnapMirror, the last transfer duration and size, and the mirror and transfer status.

name: NetApp System Health
description: Monitors CPU and memory of a NetApp cDOT or ONTAP storage system using SOAP
help: Requires .NET 4.7.2 on the probe system. Supports NetApp cDOT as of version 8.3 and NetApp ONTAP as of version 9.0 up to version 9.12.

name: NetApp System Health v2
description: Monitors the health of a node of a NetApp storage cluster via the REST API
help: Requires as of ONTAP 9.6. Requires credentials for NetApp. Shows the overall status of the node and the status of various other components such as disks, batteries, or fans, if available.

name: NetApp Volume
description: Monitors volumes of a NetApp cDOT or ONTAP storage system using SOAP
help: Requires .NET 4.7.2 on the probe system. Supports NetApp cDOT as of version 8.3 and NetApp ONTAP as of version 9.0 up to version 9.12.

name: NetApp Volume v2
description: Monitors a volume of a NetApp storage system via the REST API
help: Requires as of ONTAP 9.6. Requires credentials for NetApp. Shows the free size, free files, age of the latest and the oldest snapshot, and the number of snapshots of the volume.

name: NetFlow v5
description: Monitors a device using NetFlow v5
help: You must enable NetFlow v5 export on the device for this sensor to work.

name: NetFlow v5 (Custom)
description: Monitors a device using NetFlow v5 (customizable)
help: You must enable NetFlow v5 export on the device for this sensor to work.

name: NetFlow v9
description: Monitors a device using NetFlow v9
help: You must enable NetFlow v9 export on the device for this sensor to work.

name: NetFlow v9 (Custom)
description: Monitors a device using NetFlow v9 (customizable)
help: You must enable NetFlow v9 export on the device for this sensor to work.

name: Network Share
description: Monitors an SMB or CIFS network share
help: Shows various information about the monitored network share such as the number of files, folder size, or file age.

name: OPC UA Certificate
description: Monitors the certificate of an OPC UA server
help: Requires credentials for OPC UA. Shows the days to expiration, public key length, and if the certificate is self-signed.

name: OPC UA Custom
description: Monitors values returned by specific OPC UA NodeIDs
help: Requires credentials for OPC UA. Shows up to 10 numeric values.

name: OPC UA Server Status
description: Monitors an OPC UA server
help: Requires credentials for OPC UA. Shows the server status, uptime, and various statistics about the sessions.

name: Oracle SQL v2
description: Monitors a database on an Oracle server
help: Requires .NET 4.7.2 on the probe system. Supports Oracle database servers as of version 10.2.

name: Oracle Tablespace
description: Monitors a tablespace on an Oracle server
help: Requires .NET 4.7.2 on the probe system. Supports Oracle database servers as of version 10.2.

name: POP3
description: Monitors an email server using POP3
help: Shows the response time of the server.

name: PRTG Data Hub Process
description: Monitors the status of a PRTG Data Hub instance
help: Requires credentials for PRTG Data Hub. Shows various statistics of a PRTG Data Hub instance.

name: PRTG Data Hub Rule
description: Monitors a rule of a PRTG Data Hub instance
help: Requires credentials for PRTG Data Hub. Shows the network traffic and the status of a specific rule.

name: PRTG Data Hub Traffic
description: Monitors the traffic of a PRTG Data Hub instance
help: Requires credentials for PRTG Data Hub. Shows the network traffic and status of rules.

name: Packet Sniffer
description: Monitors headers of data packets passing a local network adapter using the built-in packet sniffer
help: Uses the monitoring port of a switch (SPAN) to monitor the traffic of other computers.

name: Packet Sniffer (Custom)
description: Monitors data packets passing a local network adapter with custom channels
help: Uses the built-in packet sniffer. Use the monitoring port of a switch (SPAN) to monitor the traffic of other computers.

name: PerfCounter Custom
description: Monitors a configured set of Windows performance counters
help: Requires credentials for Windows systems.

name: PerfCounter IIS Application Pool
description: Monitors IIS application pools using Windows performance counters
help: Requires credentials for Windows systems.

name: Ping
description: Monitors connectivity using ping
help: Shows if a device is reachable through the network using ping requests.

name: Ping Jitter
description: Monitors the statistical jitter value for pings to the parent device
help: Requires .NET 4.7.2 on the probe system.

name: Ping Jitter v2
description: Monitors the statistical jitter value for pings to the parent device
help: Shows the jitter and response times of ping requests.

name: Ping v2
description: Monitors connectivity using ping
help: Shows if a device is reachable, the minimum and maximum response time, and the packet loss.

name: Port
description: Monitors a network service by connecting to its TCP/IP port
help: Tries to connect to the specified TCP/IP port number of a device and waits for the request to be accepted.

name: Port Range
description: Monitors a network service by connecting to various TCP/IP ports
help: Tries to connect to the specified TCP/IP port numbers of a device and waits for the request to be accepted.

name: Port v2
description: Monitors a network service by connecting to one or more of its TCP/IP ports
help: Shows the time until the request to connect to the port was accepted and the number of opened and closed ports.

name: PostgreSQL
description: Monitors a database on a PostgreSQL server
help: Requires .NET 4.7.2 on the probe system.

name: Probe Health
description: Monitors the health of the probe system
help: Shows the status of a local probe, a hosted probe, a classic remote probe, or a cluster probe. Checks various parameters of the probe system that can affect the quality of the monitoring results.

name: Proxmox VE Cluster Health
description: Monitors cluster health, quorum status, and Ceph storage health for Proxmox VE clusters
help: Requires credentials for Proxmox. Requires a Proxmox VE cluster. Requires API token authentication with PVEAuditor role or higher. Requires as of Proxmox VE 6.2.

name: Proxmox VE Container Status
description: Monitors the performance metrics and status of LXC containers in Proxmox Virtual Environment
help: Requires credentials for Proxmox. Requires a Proxmox VE cluster. Requires API token authentication with PVEAuditor role or higher. Requires as of Proxmox VE 6.2.

name: Proxmox VE Node Performance
description: Monitors performance metrics of a Proxmox VE node
help: Requires credentials for Proxmox. Requires a Proxmox VE cluster. Requires API token authentication with PVEAuditor role or higher. Requires as of Proxmox VE 6.2.

name: Proxmox VE Virtual Machine Status
description: Monitors the status of a Proxmox Virtual Environment virtual machine
help: Requires credentials for Proxmox. Requires a Proxmox VE cluster. Requires API token authentication with PVEAuditor role or higher. Requires as of Proxmox VE 6.2.

name: QoS (Quality of Service) One Way
description: Monitors VoIP-relevant network parameters between two probes - in one direction
help: Sends a series of UDP packets from the parent probe to another probe and measures packet loss, jitter, PDV, MOS, etc.

name: QoS (Quality of Service) Round Trip
description: Monitors VoIP-relevant network parameters between two probes - in both directions
help: Sends a series of UDP packets back and forth between two probes and measures packet loss, jitter, PDV, MOS, etc.

name: RADIUS v2
description: Monitors a RADIUS server according to RFC 2865
help: Requires .NET 4.7.2 on the probe system.

name: RDP (Remote Desktop)
description: Monitors remote desktop services (RDP, Terminal Services Client)
help: Connects to the specified port and checks if RDP services are available.

name: RDP Client-Side Check
description: Monitors the availability and response time of the RDP service on Windows systems
help: Shows the response time of the target system to accept a TCP connection and RDP handshake request. Does not perform authentication.

name: REST Custom
description: Monitors JSON and XML REST APIs
help: This sensor will be discontinued and replaced in the future. For more information about this development, see the PRTG roadmap. Maps the JSON or XML result to sensor values using a dedicated JSON template.

name: REST Custom v2
description: Monitors JSON or XML REST APIs
help: Monitors any JSON or XML REST API and maps the result to up to 10 sensor values.

name: REST JSON Data
description: Monitors JSON REST APIs
help: Requires credentials for REST API. The data returned by the HTTP server must be in a format as defined in the Knowledge Base: [a href='https://helpdesk.paessler.com/en/support/solutions/articles/76000063370' target='_blank' rel='noopener noreferrer']]https://helpdesk.paessler.com/en/support/solutions/articles/76000063370[/a] (JSON).

name: Redfish Fan Status
description: Monitors the fans of a Redfish-capable server
help: Requires credentials for Redfish. Shows the status and, if available, the speed of the fans it monitors. Supporters of the Redfish standard include Dell, Eaton, Emerson, Fujitsu, HPE, Intel, Lenovo, NetApp, Supermicro, and VMware.

name: Redfish Power Supply
description: Monitors the power supply of a Redfish-capable server
help: Requires credentials for Redfish. Shows the overall status of the power supply, the power efficiency, and various other parameters. Supporters of the Redfish standard include Dell, Eaton, Emerson, Fujitsu, HPE, Intel, Lenovo, NetApp, Supermicro, and VMware.

name: Redfish System Health
description: Monitors the system health of a Redfish-capable server
help: Requires credentials for Redfish. Shows the overall system status and the status of various other components such as power supplies or PCIe devices, if available. Supporters of the Redfish standard include Dell, Eaton, Emerson, Fujitsu, HPE, Intel, Lenovo, NetApp, Supermicro, and VMware.

name: Redfish Temperature
description: Monitors the temperature probes of a Redfish-capable server
help: Requires credentials for Redfish. Shows the status of the temperature probes it monitors and, if available, the temperature readings from those probes. Supporters of the Redfish standard include Dell, Eaton, Emerson, Fujitsu, HPE, Intel, Lenovo, NetApp, Supermicro, and VMware.

name: Redfish Virtual Disk
description: Monitors the virtual disk of a Redfish-capable server
help: Requires credentials for Redfish. Shows the status and capacity of the virtual disk and the overall status of the connected physical disks. Supporters of the Redfish standard include Dell, Eaton, Emerson, Fujitsu, HPE, Intel, Lenovo, NetApp, Supermicro, and VMware.

name: SIMATIC S7-1200/1500 Alarm Status
description: Monitors the alarms of Siemens S7-1200/1500 PLCs via the Web API
help: Requires credentials for S7 Web API. Requires S7 Web API to be enabled on the device. Requires an S7 user account with read_diagnostics permissions.

name: SIMATIC S7-1200/1500 CPU Status
description: Monitors the CPU operating state, cycle times, and load of Siemens S7-1200/1500 PLCs via Web API
help: Requires credentials for S7 Web API. Requires S7 Web API to be enabled on the device. Requires an S7 user account with read_diagnostics permissions.

name: SIMATIC S7-1200/1500 Hardware Status
description: Monitors the status and fault count of hardware modules and PROFINET IO devices connected to Siemens S7-1200/1500 PLCs via Web API
help: Requires credentials for S7 Web API. Requires S7 Web API to be enabled on the device. Requires an S7 user account with read_diagnostics permissions.

name: SIMATIC S7-300/400 CPU Restart Overview
description: Monitors the CPU restart events of a SIMATIC S7-300 or S7-400 controller
help: Requires connection settings for Siemens S7. Shows the latest CPU restart event and the number of all restart events.

name: SIMATIC S7-300/400 CPU Status
description: Monitors the CPU status of a SIMATIC S7-300 or S7-400 controller
help: Shows the CPU status, cycle ratios, and cycle times.

name: SIMATIC S7-300/400 LED Status
description: Monitors the physical LEDs on the front panel of a SIMATIC S7-300 or S7-400 controller
help: Requires connection settings for Siemens S7. Shows the status of the physical LEDs on the front panel of the device.

name: SIP Options Ping
description: Monitors connectivity for an SIP server using SIP options "ping"
help: Requires .NET 4.7.2 on the probe system. You can use this sensor to monitor VoIP services.

name: SMTP
description: Monitors an email server using SMTP
help: Optionally sends a test email with every check. Shows the response time of the server.

name: SMTP&IMAP Round Trip
description: Monitors the time it takes for an email to reach an IMAP mailbox after being sent using SMTP
help: Sends an email using the parent device (an SMTP server) and then checks an IMAP mailbox until the email comes in.

name: SMTP&POP3 Round Trip
description: Monitors the time it takes for an email to reach a POP3 mailbox after being sent using SMTP
help: Sends an email using the parent device (an SMTP server) and then checks a POP3 mailbox until the email comes in.

name: SNMP APC Hardware
description: Monitors performance counters on APC UPS hardware
help: Use custom sensors to monitor additional counters and APC UPS without SNMP.

name: SNMP Buffalo TS System Health
description: Monitors the system health of a Buffalo TeraStation NAS using SNMP
help: Shows errors, warnings, resource usage, and uptime for a Buffalo TeraStation NAS. Some systems, depending on model and firmware, might only support some of the values.

name: SNMP CPU Load
description: Monitors the load of a CPU via SNMP
help: To query data from a probe device (localhost, 127.0.0.1, or ::1), add this device to PRTG with the IP address it has in your network and create the sensor on this device.

name: SNMP CPU Usage
description: Monitors the usage of the CPU cores of a system via SNMP
help: Requires credentials for SNMP. Shows the CPU usage of each system core and the average CPU usage across all cores.

name: SNMP Cisco ADSL
description: Monitors ADSL statistics of a Cisco router using SNMP
help: Shows the speed of uplink and downlink, remote and local attenuation, SNR, and power output.

name: SNMP Cisco ASA VPN Connections
description: Monitors VPN connections on a Cisco ASA
help: Shows active email, IPsec, L2L, LB, SVC sessions, active sessions, active users, and groups with active users.

name: SNMP Cisco ASA VPN Traffic
description: Monitors the traffic for IPsec VPN tunnels on a Cisco ASA
help: Requires permanent IPsec connections. Shows an error if a connection is interrupted.

name: SNMP Cisco ASA VPN Users
description: Monitors which users are connected to a VPN on a Cisco ASA
help: Shows the account status of up to 50 simultaneously connected VPN users.

name: SNMP Cisco CBQoS
description: Monitors network parameters using Cisco's CBQoS via SNMP
help: Supports the classes Class Map, Match Statement, and Queueing.

name: SNMP Cisco System Health
description: Monitors the system health of a Cisco device
help: Shows CPU load, available memory, status of power supplies, current temperature, and temperature status.

name: SNMP Cisco UCS Blade
description: Monitors the health of a blade server in a Cisco UCS device
help: Shows operability, oper state, and power state.

name: SNMP Cisco UCS Chassis
description: Monitors the health of the chassis of a Cisco UCS device
help: Shows the property states for configuration, license, oper, operability, power, thermal, and SEEPROM.

name: SNMP Cisco UCS Physical Disk
description: Monitors the physical disk of a Cisco UCS device
help: Shows the operability status and connection status of the disk.

name: SNMP Cisco UCS System Health
description: Monitors the system health of a Cisco UCS device
help: Shows the number of operable and inoperable fans, fan modules, power supplies, and the status of several other components.

name: SNMP Custom
description: Monitors a numeric value returned by a specific OID using SNMP
help: To monitor more than one OID, use the SNMP Custom Advanced sensor instead.

name: SNMP Custom Advanced
description: Monitors numeric values returned by up to 10 specific OIDs using SNMP
help: To monitor only one OID, use the SNMP Custom sensor instead.

name: SNMP Custom String
description: Monitors a string returned by a specific OID using SNMP
help: You can extract a numeric value contained in the string and set limits for this value.

name: SNMP Custom String Lookup
description: Monitors a string value returned by a specific OID using SNMP and lookups
help: Requires a lookup that contains all possible strings that the target system can return. The string match is not case-sensitive.

name: SNMP Custom String v2
description: Monitors a string returned by a specific OID using SNMP
help: Requires credentials for SNMP. Searches for a string, an IPv4 address, or a MAC address in the binary result from the SNMP host.

name: SNMP Custom Table
description: Monitors entries from a table that is provided via SNMP
help: Shows numeric values in up to 10 channels per table row.

name: SNMP Custom v2
description: Monitors numeric values returned by up to ten specific OIDs or ASN.1 MIB names using SNMP
help: Requires credentials for SNMP.

name: SNMP Dell EqualLogic Logical Disk
description: Monitors a logical disk of a Dell EqualLogic storage system
help: Shows availability, average read/write latency, data volume, number of connections and IOPS, and operational status.

name: SNMP Dell EqualLogic Member Health
description: Monitors a storage array member of a Dell EqualLogic storage system
help: Requires credentials for SNMP devices. This sensor only supports SNMP v2c or SNMP v3.

name: SNMP Dell EqualLogic Physical Disk
description: Monitors a physical disk of a Dell EqualLogic storage system
help: Shows disk status, bytes read/written, failed transfers, and health status of disk.

name: SNMP Dell Hardware
description: Monitors performance counters on a Dell hardware device
help: Requires Dell OpenManage Server Administrator on the target device.

name: SNMP Dell PowerEdge Physical Disk
description: Monitors a physical disk in a Dell PowerEdge server
help: Requires iDRAC 7 or Dell OpenManage Server Administrator on the target device.

name: SNMP Dell PowerEdge System Health
description: Monitors the system health of a Dell PowerEdge server
help: Requires iDRAC 7 or Dell OpenManage Server Administrator on the target device.

name: SNMP Disk Free
description: Monitors the free disk space on a logical disk via SNMP
help: Uses more generic OID values compared to the SNMP Linux Disk Free sensor.

name: SNMP Disk Free v2
description: Monitors the free disk space on a logical disk via SNMP
help: Requires credentials for SNMP. Uses HOST-RESOURCES-V2-MIB::hrStorageTable.

name: SNMP Fujitsu System Health v2
description: Monitors the system health of a Fujitsu PRIMERGY server via the integrated Remote Management Controller (iRMC)
help: Shows overall status, CPU status, memory module status, and status of power supplies. Also monitors RAID status and disk status if available (requires iRMC S5 and PRIMERGY M4).

name: SNMP HP LaserJet Hardware
description: Monitors performance counters on an HP LaserJet printer
help: Supports some HP OfficeJet printers. Shows the status of toner, paper, and paper jam, depending on what category you monitor.

name: SNMP HPE BladeSystem Blade
description: Monitors the server blades of an HPE BladeSystem
help: Requires a device whose IP address/DNS name points to the HPE BladeSystem Enclosure hosting the Onboard Administrator.

name: SNMP HPE BladeSystem Enclosure Health
description: Monitors the enclosure health of an HPE BladeSystem device via SNMP
help: Requires a device whose IP address/DNS name points to the HPE BladeSystem Enclosure hosting the Onboard Administrator.

name: SNMP HPE ProLiant Logical Disk
description: Monitors a logical disk in an HPE server
help: Requires HPE Agentless Management and the HPE Agentless Management Service on the target device.

name: SNMP HPE ProLiant Memory Controller
description: Monitors a memory controller in an HPE server
help: Requires HPE Agentless Management and the HPE Agentless Management Service on the target device.

name: SNMP HPE ProLiant Network Interface
description: Monitors a network interface in an HPE server
help: Requires HPE Agentless Management and the HPE Agentless Management Service on the target device.

name: SNMP HPE ProLiant Physical Disk
description: Monitors a physical disk in an HPE server
help: Requires HPE Agentless Management and the HPE Agentless Management Service on the target device.

name: SNMP HPE ProLiant System Health
description: Monitors the system health of an HPE server
help: Use the HPE iLO interface as the parent device for this sensor.

name: SNMP Hardware Status
description: Monitors the status of a server component via SNMP
help: To query data from a probe device (localhost, 127.0.0.1, or ::1), add this device to PRTG with the IP address it has in your network and create the sensor on this device.

name: SNMP IBM System X Logical Disk
description: Monitors a logical disk in an IBM server
help: Requires IBM Systems Director Platform on the target device.

name: SNMP IBM System X Physical Disk
description: Monitors a physical disk in an IBM server
help: Requires IBM Systems Director Platform on the target device.

name: SNMP IBM System X Physical Memory
description: Monitors the memory modules in an IBM server
help: Requires IBM Systems Director Platform on the target device.

name: SNMP IBM System X System Health
description: Monitors the system health of an IBM device
help: Requires IBM Systems Director Platform on the target device.

name: SNMP Juniper NS System Health
description: Monitors the system health of a Juniper NetScreen device
help: Shows CPU utilization, fan and power supply status, system temperature, and memory and session usage.

name: SNMP LenovoEMC Physical Disk
description: Monitors a physical disk in a LenovoEMC NAS using SNMP
help: Shows the overall disk status.

name: SNMP LenovoEMC System Health
description: Monitors the system health of a LenovoEMC NAS using SNMP
help: Shows the overall status of the RAID.

name: SNMP Library
description: Monitors a device using SNMP and compiled MIB files (.oidlib files)
help: Monitors SNMP devices using your imported MIB files, including Cisco interfaces and queue, APC UPS (battery ems status), Linux (AX BGP DisMan EtherLike Host Framework Proxy Noti v2 IP Net Noti OSPF RMON SMUX Source TCP UCD UDP).

name: SNMP Linux Block Device I/O
description: Monitors I/O on disks of a Linux/Unix system using SNMP
help: Requires credentials for SNMP. Shows read and written bytes, and the number of read and write accesses. Uses UCD-DISKIO-MIB::diskIOTable.

name: SNMP Linux Disk Free
description: Monitors free space on disks of a Linux/Unix system using SNMP
help: Uses more specific OID values compared to the SNMP Disk Free sensor.

name: SNMP Linux Disk Free v2
description: Monitors free space on disks of a Linux/Unix system using SNMP
help: Requires credentials for SNMP. Shows the free space and free INodes of different disks. Uses UCD-DISKIO-MIB.

name: SNMP Linux Load Average
description: Monitors system load average of a Linux/Unix system using SNMP
help: Shows the average system load within a scanning interval of 1, 5, or 15 minutes.

name: SNMP Linux Load Average v2
description: Monitors system load average of a Linux/Unix system via SNMP
help: Requires credentials for SNMP. Shows the average system load in intervals of 1, 5, and 15 minutes.

name: SNMP Linux Meminfo
description: Monitors memory usage of a Linux/Unix system using SNMP
help: Shows available memory, used and free swap memory, and more memory data.

name: SNMP Linux Meminfo v2
description: Monitors the memory usage of a Linux/Unix system using SNMP
help: Requires credentials for SNMP. Shows the available memory, free physical memory, and other metrics related to memory.

name: SNMP Linux Physical Disk
description: Monitors I/O on disks of a Linux/Unix system using SNMP
help: Shows read and written bytes, and the number of read and write accesses.

name: SNMP Memory
description: Monitors the memory usage of a system via SNMP
help: To query data from a probe device (localhost, 127.0.0.1, or ::1), add this device to PRTG with the IP address it has in your network and create the sensor on this device.

name: SNMP Memory v2
description: Monitors the memory usage of a system via SNMP
help: Requires credentials for SNMP. Shows the available and total memory.

name: SNMP NetApp Disk Free
description: Monitors free space on disks of a NetApp storage system using SNMP
help: Shows free disk space, deduplication space, disk free status, free files, and free INodes.

name: SNMP NetApp Enclosure
description: Monitors the power supply and cooling of an enclosure that is part of a NetApp storage system using SNMP
help: Supports NetApp versions up to 8.2

name: SNMP NetApp I/O
description: Monitors traffic and disk throughput (IOPS) of a NetApp storage system using SNMP
help: Supports NetApp versions up to 8.2. For NetApp cDOT as of version 8.3 or NetApp ONTAP as of version 9.0, use the NetApp I/O sensor instead.

name: SNMP NetApp License
description: Monitors licenses for the services of a NetApp storage system using SNMP
help: Supports NetApp versions up to 8.2.

name: SNMP NetApp Logical Unit
description: Monitors the IOPS on a logical unit of a NetApp storage system using SNMP
help: Supports NetApp versions up to 8.2. For NetApp cDOT as of version 8.3 or NetApp ONTAP as of version 9.0, use the NetApp LUN sensor instead.

name: SNMP NetApp Network Interface
description: Monitors a network interface on a NetApp storage system using SNMP
help: Supports NetApp versions up to 8.2. For NetApp cDOT as of version 8.3 or NetApp ONTAP as of version 9.0, use the NetApp NIC sensor instead.

name: SNMP NetApp System Health
description: Monitors key data of a NetApp storage system using SNMP
help: For NetApp cDOT as of version 8.3 or NetApp ONTAP as of version 9.0, use the NetApp System Health sensor instead.

name: SNMP Nutanix Cluster Health
description: Monitors the cluster status and performance metrics
help: Nutanix devices only support SNMP v3. Make sure that you select SNMP v3 in the credentials for SNMP devices in the settings of the parent device or group.

name: SNMP Nutanix Hypervisor
description: Monitors a Nutanix hypervisor
help: Nutanix devices only support SNMP v3. Make sure that you select SNMP v3 in the credentials for SNMP devices in the settings of the parent device or group.

name: SNMP Poseidon Environment
description: Monitors performance counters for environmental measurements on Poseidon hardware
help: Shows humidity and temperature.

name: SNMP Printer
description: Monitors the status of a printer via SNMP
help: Supports HP OfficeJet, HP LaserJet, RICOH SP 5200, SP 3410, SP C242DN, MP C3003, and MP C2503 among others.

name: SNMP Printer v2
description: Monitors the status of a printer via SNMP
help: Requires credentials for SNMP. Monitors printer status and consumables. Supports network printers that implement the Printer-MIB standard (RFC 3805), such as HP (LaserJet, OfficeJet), Ricoh, Samsung, and other manufacturers.

name: SNMP QNAP Logical Disk
description: Monitors a logical disk in a QNAP NAS using SNMP
help: Shows free disk space and volume status.

name: SNMP QNAP Physical Disk
description: Monitors a physical disk in a QNAP NAS using SNMP
help: Shows temperature, disk status, and S.M.A.R.T. status.

name: SNMP QNAP System Health
description: Monitors the system health of a QNAP NAS using SNMP
help: Shows CPU usage, available memory, CPU and system temperature, and revolution of fans.

name: SNMP RMON
description: Monitors a network switch port by port using SNMP and RMON
help: To query data from a probe device (localhost, 127.0.0.1, or ::1), add this device to PRTG with the IP address it has in your network and create the sensor on this device.

name: SNMP RMON v2
description: Monitors network switch ports using SNMP and the RMON MIB standard
help: Requires credentials for SNMP. Shows detailed traffic statistics, packet size distribution, error rates, and collision metrics per port.

name: SNMP Rittal CMC III Hardware Status
description: Monitors the system health of a Rittal CMC III processing unit via SNMP
help: Shows the overall status of the Rittal CMC III processing unit and the hardware status of every attached external sensor.

name: SNMP SonicWall System Health
description: Monitors the system health of a SonicWall NSA via SNMP
help: Shows CPU, memory, and connection cache usage.

name: SNMP SonicWall VPN Traffic
description: Monitors the traffic of an IPsec VPN on a SonicWall NSA via SNMP
help: Shows encrypted and decrypted packets and transmissions, and ingoing and outgoing fragmented packets.

name: SNMP Synology Logical Disk
description: Monitors a logical disk in a Synology NAS using SNMP
help: Shows the volume status.

name: SNMP Synology Physical Disk
description: Monitors a physical disk in a Synology NAS using SNMP
help: Shows temperature and disk status.

name: SNMP Synology System Health
description: Monitors the system health of a Synology NAS using SNMP
help: Shows temperature, memory usage, CPU load, fan status, system status, and power status.

name: SNMP System Uptime
description: Monitors the uptime of a device using SNMP
help: To query data from a probe device (localhost, 127.0.0.1, or ::1), add this device to PRTG with the IP address it has in your network and create the sensor on this device.

name: SNMP Traffic
description: Monitors bandwidth and traffic on servers, PCs, switches, etc. using SNMP
help: To query data from a probe device (localhost, 127.0.0.1, or ::1), add this device to PRTG with the IP address it has in your network and create the sensor on this device.

name: SNMP Traffic v2
description: Monitors bandwidth and traffic on servers, PCs, switches, etc. using SNMP
help: Requires credentials for SNMP. Shows the speed and volume of incoming and outgoing traffic.

name: SNMP Trap Receiver
description: Receives and analyzes SNMP trap messages
help: Does not support SNMP v3 traps. Use SNMP v1 or v2c instead.

name: SNMP UPS Status
description: Monitors the system status of a UPS via SNMP
help: Requires credentials for SNMP. Shows the battery status and current load.

name: SNMP Uptime v2
description: Monitors the uptime of a device using SNMP
help: Requires credentials for SNMP.

name: SNMP Windows Service
description: Monitors a Windows service using SNMP
help: To query data from a probe device (localhost, 127.0.0.1, or ::1), add this device to PRTG with the IP address it has in your network and create the sensor on this device.

name: SNMP Windows Service v2
description: Monitors the status of a Windows service via SNMP
help: Requires credentials for SNMP. Shows the operating state of a Windows service. Uses LanMgr-Mib-II-MIB. The target system must support the LAN Manager MIB. Note: PRTG cannot find stopped services via SNMP.

name: SNMP interSeptor Pro Environment
description: Monitors temperature and humidity on a Jacarta interSeptor Pro environmental monitoring device
help: In the Jacarta web interface, make sure that the IP address of the PRTG installation is allowed to access data via SNMP. Otherwise, you will not be able to create this sensor.

name: SNTP
description: Monitors an SNTP server
help: Shows the response time of the server and the time difference in comparison to the local system time.

name: SNTP v2
description: Monitors the time synchronization against an NTP server
help: Shows the response time of the server, the time offset in comparison to the local system time, and the stratum level of the server.

name: SSH Disk Free v2
description: Monitors the available disk space of a Linux/Unix system with SSH
help: Requires credentials for Linux/Solaris/macOS (SSH/WBEM) systems. Shows the free space of different disks and the total available disk space of the entire system.

name: SSH INodes Free v2
description: Monitors free INodes on disks of a Linux/Unix or macOS system with SSH
help: Requires credentials for Linux/Solaris/macOS (SSH/WBEM) systems. Does not support ESX(i) hosts.

name: SSH Load Average v2
description: Monitors load average of a Linux/Unix or macOS system with SSH
help: Requires credentials for Linux/Solaris/macOS (SSH/WBEM) systems.

name: SSH Meminfo v2
description: Monitors memory usage of a Linux/Unix system with SSH
help: Requires credentials for Linux/Solaris/macOS (SSH/WBEM) systems.

name: SSH Remote Ping v2
description: Remotely monitors the connectivity between a Linux/macOS system and another device using ping and SSH
help: Requires credentials for Linux/Solaris/macOS (SSH/WBEM) systems.

name: SSH SAN Enclosure
description: Monitors the health of an enclosure on a SAN that supports CLI over SSH, for example the HPE P2000
help: Requires credentials for Linux/Solaris/macOS (SSH/WBEM) systems.

name: SSH SAN Logical Disk
description: Monitors a logical disk on a SAN that supports CLI over SSH, for example the HPE P2000
help: Requires credentials for Linux/Solaris/macOS (SSH/WBEM) systems.

name: SSH SAN Physical Disk
description: Monitors a physical disk on a SAN that supports CLI over SSH, for example the HPE P2000
help: Requires credentials for Linux/Solaris/macOS (SSH/WBEM) systems.

name: SSH SAN System Health
description: Monitors the system health on a SAN that supports CLI over SSH, for example the HPE P2000
help: Requires credentials for Linux/Solaris/macOS (SSH/WBEM) systems.

name: SSH Script
description: Connects to a Linux/Unix system using SSH and runs a custom script that returns a numeric value
help: Requires credentials for Linux/Solaris/macOS (SSH/WBEM) systems.

name: SSH Script Advanced
description: Connects to a Linux/Unix system using SSH and runs a custom script that returns XML or JSON
help: Requires credentials for Linux/Solaris/macOS (SSH/WBEM) systems.

name: SSH Script v2
description: Connects to a Linux/Unix system with SSH and runs a custom script that returns data in JSON
help: Requires credentials for Linux/Solaris/macOS (SSH/WBEM) systems.

name: SSL Certificate
description: Monitors the certificate of an SSL/TLS-secured connection
help: The parent device address can be a DNS name (for example, 'localdevice', 'remotedevice.com'), an IP address (for example, '127.0.0.1'), or an HTTPS URL (for example, 'https://www.paessler.com', 'www.paessler.com').

name: SSL Security Check
description: Monitors the SSL/TLS connectivity of a TCP/IP port
help: Tries to connect to the specified TCP/IP port number with different SSL/TLS protocols.

name: SSL/TLS Certificate
description: Monitors the certificate of an SSL/TLS-secured connection
help: Shows the days to expiration, the revocation and trust status, and if the certificate is self-signed.

name: SSL/TLS Security Check
description: Monitors the security of an SSL/TLS-secured connection
help: Shows which protocols are accepted or denied by the server according to the sensor settings.

name: Script v2
description: Runs a script or native executable that returns data in JSON format
help: You must store the scripts and executables on the probe system.[br][br]PowerShell scripts (.ps1) require PowerShell 7 on the probe system. PRTG does not support Windows PowerShell 5.1.

name: Sensor Factory
description: Create your own sensor with channels based on data from other sensors
help: Define one or more channels using formulas that combine monitoring results from other sensors. We recommend that you do not use more than 50 sensors of this sensor type per PRTG installation.

name: Share Disk Free
description: Monitors free disk space of a share (Windows/Samba) using SMB
help: Requires credentials for Windows systems.

name: Soffico Orchestra Channel Health
description: Monitors the status of an Orchestra channel
help: Shows the status of the adapter and the number of successful and unsuccessful channel calls.

name: Soffico Orchestra Scenario
description: Monitors the status of processes within an Orchestra scenario
help: Requires credentials for Soffico Orchestra. Shows the number of running, paused, finished, etc. processes in an Orchestra scenario.

name: Syslog Receiver
description: Receives and analyzes Syslog messages
help: Shows the number of received Syslog messages, messages categorized as warning or error, and dropped packets.

name: System Health
description: Monitors the health of the system running PRTG
help: Shows system health, available memory, and system CPU load.

name: TFTP
description: Monitors a TFTP server
help: Shows the response time of the server.

name: Traceroute Hop Count
description: Monitors the number of hops from the probe to the parent device and alerts if the route has changed
help: Requires .NET 4.7.2 on the probe system.

name: Traceroute Hop Count v2
description: Monitors the number of hops from the probe to the parent device
help: Shows the number of hops. Also shows the detected route in the sensor message.

name: VMware Datastore (REST)
description: Monitors a VMware datastore using the VMware REST API
help: Requires credentials for VMware vSphere. Shows the capacity, free space, and accessibility of the datastore.

name: VMware Datastore (SOAP)
description: Monitors disk usage and accessibility of a VMware datastore using SOAP
help: Requires .NET 4.7.2 on the probe system. Requires credentials for VMware/XenServer. The parent device must be a VMware ESXi server or vCenter as of version 5.0.

name: VMware Host Hardware (WBEM)
description: Monitors hardware information of an ESXi server using WBEM
help: Requires credentials for Linux/Solaris/macOS (SSH/WBEM) systems. The parent device must be a VMware ESXi server as of version 5.0.

name: VMware Host Hardware Status (SOAP)
description: Monitors the hardware health status of a VMware host server using SOAP
help: Requires .NET 4.7.2 on the probe system. Requires credentials for VMware/XenServer. The parent device must be a VMware ESXi server or vCenter as of version 5.0.

name: VMware Host Performance (SOAP)
description: Monitors the performance of a VMware host server or VMware Workstation using SOAP
help: Requires .NET 4.7.2 on the probe system. Requires credentials for VMware/XenServer. The parent device must be a VMware ESXi server or vCenter as of version 5.0, or a VMware Workstation as of version 8.0.

name: VMware Virtual Machine (SOAP)
description: Monitors virtual machines on a VMware host server using SOAP
help: Requires .NET 4.7.2 on the probe system. Requires credentials for VMware/XenServer. The parent device must be a VMware ESXi server or vCenter as of version 5.0.

name: Veeam Backup Job Status
description: Monitors the status of all backup job runs on the Veeam Backup Enterprise Manager in the last 24 hours
help: Requires an installation of the Veeam Backup Enterprise Manager 10, 11, or 12 with the Enterprise Plus license. Requires credentials for Veeam. Shows the number of successful, failed, and finished backup jobs runs and the number of scheduled jobs.

name: Veeam Backup Job Status Advanced
description: Monitors the status of a specific backup job that runs on the Veeam Backup Enterprise Manager
help: Requires an installation of the Veeam Backup Enterprise Manager 10, 11, or 12 with the Enterprise Plus license. Requires credentials for Veeam. Shows the status of the last result, if the job is scheduled, and duration of the last backup job.

name: WMI Battery
description: Monitors the available capacity and the state of connected batteries of Windows-based devices
help: Requires credentials for Windows systems. Does not support Windows XP or older.

name: WMI CPU Load v2
description: Monitors the CPU load of a Windows system via WMI and the WSMan protocol. Provides overall CPU utilization and per-core utilization for all logical processors
help: Requires credentials for Windows systems. Requires permissions on the target system. For more information, see the sensor page in the PRTG Manual and the Knowledge Base: [a href='https://helpdesk.paessler.com/en/support/solutions/articles/76000088235?utm_source=prtg&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=webgui-kb' target='_blank']]How can I use a non-administrator Windows account for WMI monitoring via the WSMan protocol?[/a]

name: WMI Custom
description: Performs a custom WMI query and monitors numeric values
help: Requires credentials for Windows systems. The WQL query code must be stored in a file on the probe system and must return integer or float values. If it returns strings, use the WMI Custom String sensor instead.

name: WMI Custom String
description: Performs a custom WMI query and shows the returned string
help: Requires credentials for Windows systems. The WQL query code must be stored in a file on the probe system and must return string values. If it returns numeric values, use the WMI Custom sensor instead.

name: WMI Disk Health
description: Monitors the health of physical disks and provides useful information about disk performance
help: Requires credentials for Windows systems. Supports Windows version as of Windows 10 or Windows Server 2016.

name: WMI Event Log
description: Monitors event log entries using WMI
help: Requires credentials for Windows systems.

name: WMI Exchange Server
description: Monitors a Microsoft Exchange Server using WMI
help: Requires credentials for Windows systems.

name: WMI Exchange Transport Queue
description: Monitors the transport queue of a Microsoft Exchange server
help: Requires credentials for Windows systems. Reads the 'MSExchangeTransport Queues' object and returns the same data you see in Windows System Monitor.

name: WMI File
description: Monitors a file using WMI
help: Requires credentials for Windows systems.

name: WMI Free Disk Space (Multi Disk)
description: Monitors free space of one or more local disk drives (one channel per disk)
help: Requires credentials for Windows systems.

name: WMI HDD Health
description: Monitors the health of IDE disk drives using S.M.A.R.T.
help: Requires credentials for Windows systems. Supports as of Windows 10 on the target system. S.M.A.R.T. is built into most modern IDE drives.

name: WMI Logical Disk I/O
description: Monitors disk data and mount points on a Windows system
help: Requires credentials for Windows systems. Shows read/write time, transfer time, I/O, queue length, and free space.

name: WMI Memory
description: Monitors available (free) system memory on Windows systems using WMI
help: Requires credentials for Windows systems.

name: WMI Memory v2
description: Monitors used and available memory on a Windows system via WMI and the WSMan protocol
help: Requires credentials for Windows systems. Requires permissions on the target system. For more information, see the sensor page in the PRTG Manual and the Knowledge Base: [a href='https://helpdesk.paessler.com/en/support/solutions/articles/76000088235?utm_source=prtg&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=webgui-kb' target='_blank']]How can I use a non-administrator Windows account for WMI monitoring via the WSMan protocol?[/a]

name: WMI Microsoft SQL Server
description: Monitors the performance of a Microsoft SQL Server instance via WMI and the WSMan protocol
help: Requires credentials for Windows systems. Requires permissions on the target system. For more information, see the sensor page in the PRTG Manual and the Knowledge Base: [a href='https://helpdesk.paessler.com/en/support/solutions/articles/76000088235?utm_source=prtg&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=webgui-kb' target='_blank']]How can I use a non-administrator Windows account for WMI monitoring via the WSMan protocol?[/a]

name: WMI Microsoft SQL Server 2005
description: Monitors the performance of an instance of Microsoft SQL Server 2005. Might not work with the latest version of SQL Server 2005
help: Requires credentials for Windows systems.

name: WMI Microsoft SQL Server 2008
description: Monitors the performance of an instance of Microsoft SQL Server 2008
help: Requires credentials for Windows systems.

name: WMI Microsoft SQL Server 2012
description: Monitors the performance of an instance of Microsoft SQL Server 2012
help: Requires credentials for Windows systems.

name: WMI Microsoft SQL Server 2014
description: Monitors the performance of an instance of Microsoft SQL Server 2014
help: Requires credentials for Windows systems.

name: WMI Microsoft SQL Server 2016
description: Monitors the performance of an instance of Microsoft SQL Server 2016
help: Requires credentials for Windows systems.

name: WMI Microsoft SQL Server 2017
description: Monitors the performance of an instance of Microsoft SQL Server 2017
help: Requires credentials for Windows systems.

name: WMI Microsoft SQL Server 2019
description: Monitors the performance of an instance of Microsoft SQL Server 2019
help: Requires credentials for Windows systems.

name: WMI Microsoft SQL Server 2022
description: Monitors the performance of an instance of Microsoft SQL Server 2022
help: Requires credentials for Windows systems.

name: WMI Network Card v2
description: Monitors bandwidth usage and traffic statistics of a Windows network adapter via WMI and the WSMan protocol
help: Requires credentials for Windows systems. Requires membership in the Remote Management Users group and access permissions for the WMI namespace root\CIMv2 on the target system.

name: WMI Pagefile v2
description: Monitors usage of the Windows pagefile on a Windows system via WMI
help: Requires credentials for Windows systems. Requires permissions on the target system. For more information, see the sensor page in the PRTG Manual and the Knowledge Base: [a href='https://helpdesk.paessler.com/en/support/solutions/articles/76000088235?utm_source=prtg&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=webgui-kb' target='_blank']]How can I use a non-administrator Windows account for WMI monitoring via the WSMan protocol?[/a]

name: WMI Print Queue v2
description: Monitors the number of print jobs in a Windows print queue
help: Requires credentials for Windows systems. Requires a local administrator account on the target system.

name: WMI Remote Ping
description: Remotely monitors the connectivity between a system running Windows and an other device, using ping and WMI
help: Requires credentials for Windows systems.

name: WMI Security Center
description: Monitors the status of security software on a Windows client as reported by Windows Security Center
help: Requires credentials for Windows systems. Use this sensor to monitor the status of antivirus software, spyware removal software, and firewalls that run on a Windows client. Does not support Windows Server.

name: WMI Service
description: Monitors a Windows service using WMI
help: Requires credentials for Windows systems.

name: WMI Service v2
description: Monitors a Windows service via WMI and the WSMan protocol
help: Requires credentials for Windows systems. Requires permissions on the target system. For more information, see the sensor page in the PRTG Manual and the Knowledge Base: [a href='https://helpdesk.paessler.com/en/support/solutions/articles/76000088235?utm_source=prtg&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=webgui-kb' target='_blank']]How can I use a non-administrator Windows account for WMI monitoring via the WSMan protocol?[/a]

name: WMI Share
description: Monitors a shared resource on a Windows system using WMI
help: Requires credentials for Windows systems.

name: WMI SharePoint Process
description: Monitors processes on a Microsoft SharePoint server using WMI
help: Requires credentials for Windows systems.

name: WMI Storage Pool
description: Monitors the available storage pools, their operational and health status, and free space
help: Requires credentials for Windows systems. Supports Windows versions as of Windows 10 or Windows Server 2016.

name: WMI System Uptime v2
description: Monitors the uptime of a Windows system via WMI and the WSMan protocol
help: Requires credentials for Windows systems. Requires permissions on the target system. For more information, see the sensor page in the PRTG Manual and the Knowledge Base: [a href='https://helpdesk.paessler.com/en/support/solutions/articles/76000088235?utm_source=prtg&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=webgui-kb' target='_blank']]How can I use a non-administrator Windows account for WMI monitoring via the WSMan protocol?[/a]

name: WMI Terminal Services (Windows 2008+)
description: Monitors the number of sessions on a Windows Terminal Services server using WMI as of Windows Server 2008
help: Requires credentials for Windows systems.

name: WMI Terminal Services (Windows XP/Vista/2003)
description: Monitors the number of sessions on a Windows Terminal Services server using WMI
help: Requires credentials for Windows systems.

name: WMI UTC Time
description: Monitors the UTC time of a device using WMI
help: Requires credentials for Windows systems. The UTC Time value is compared to the PRTG system time.

name: WMI Vital System Data v2
description: Monitors vital system parameters using WMI (CPU, memory, disk, network)
help: Requires credentials for Windows systems.

name: WMI Volume
description: Monitors free disk space on a drive, logical volume, or mount point using WMI
help: Requires credentials for Windows systems. Does not support Windows XP and older.

name: WMI Volume v2
description: Monitors free disk space on a Windows volume (drive, logical volume, or mount point) using WMI and the WSMan protocol
help: Requires credentials for Windows systems. Requires permissions on the target system. For more information, see the sensor page in the PRTG Manual and the Knowledge Base: [a href='https://helpdesk.paessler.com/en/support/solutions/articles/76000088235?utm_source=prtg&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=webgui-kb' target='_blank']]How can I use a non-administrator Windows account for WMI monitoring via the WSMan protocol?[/a]

name: WMI Windows Security
description: Monitors the status of security products on a Windows client system via WMI and the WSMan protocol
help: Requires credentials for Windows systems. Requires membership in the Remote Management Users group and access permissions for the WMI namespace root\SecurityCenter2 on the target system. This sensor does not support Windows Server operating systems.

name: WSUS Statistics
description: Retrieves various statistics on a WSUS server using WMI
help: Requires the WSUS 3.0 Administration Console and .NET 4.7.2 on the probe system. Requires credentials for Windows systems.

name: Windows CPU Load
description: Monitors CPU load using performance counters or WMI
help: Requires credentials for Windows systems.

name: Windows IIS Application
description: Monitors a Microsoft IIS installation using WMI
help: Requires credentials for Windows systems. Also monitors applications that use IIS, such as Microsoft SharePoint or Microsoft Reporting Services (SSRS).

name: Windows MSMQ Queue Length
description: Counts the number of messages in a Microsoft message queue
help: Requires .NET 4.7.2 on the probe system. Requires credentials for Windows systems. You must start the MSMQ service on the probe and target systems.

name: Windows Network Card
description: Monitors bandwidth usage and traffic of a network interface using performance counters or WMI
help: Requires credentials for Windows systems.

name: Windows Pagefile
description: Monitors Windows pagefile usage using performance counters or WMI
help: Requires credentials for Windows systems.

name: Windows Physical Disk I/O
description: Monitors accumulated disk data on a Windows system
help: Requires credentials for Windows systems. Shows read/write time and bytes, average transfer time, queue length, and I/O.

name: Windows Print Queue
description: Monitors the number of jobs in a print queue
help: Requires .NET 4.7.2 on the probe system. Requires credentials for Windows systems.

name: Windows Process
description: Monitors performance counters of a Windows process
help: Requires credentials for Windows systems.

name: Windows SMTP Service Received
description: Monitors the number of received emails for a Windows SMTP service
help: Requires credentials for Windows systems.

name: Windows SMTP Service Sent
description: Monitors the number of sent emails for a Windows SMTP service
help: Requires credentials for Windows systems.

name: Windows System Uptime
description: Monitors the uptime of a Windows system using performance counters or WMI
help: Requires credentials for Windows systems.

name: Windows Updates Status (PowerShell)
description: Monitors the Windows updates status from Microsoft or from the local WSUS server
help: Requires .NET 4.7.2 and as of PowerShell 3.0 on the probe system. Requires Remote PowerShell access on the target system. Requires credentials for Windows systems.

name: ZEN
description: The ZEN of PRTG
help: Deep thoughts for the network administrator. This sensor always shows the Unknown status.

name: Zoom Service Status
description: Monitors the status of all Zoom services
help: Shows the overall status of Zoom groups based on the operational status of their components and the status of unassigned components.

name: jFlow v5
description: Monitors a device using jFlow v5
help: Requires jFlow v5 export on the device.

name: jFlow v5 (Custom)
description: Monitors a device using jFlow v5 (customizable)
help: Requires jFlow v5 export on the device.

name: sFlow
description: Monitors a device using sFlow v5
help: You must enable sFlow v5 export on the device for this sensor to work.

name: sFlow (Custom)
description: Monitors a device using sFlow v5 (customizable)
help: You must enable sFlow v5 export on the device for this sensor to work.
